newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian Airlines cancels flights to Kinshasa.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian Airlines cancels flights to Kinshasa.

text.p: Ethiopian Airlines said on Friday it had cancelled its two flights a week to Zaire's capital and was diverting them to Lome, Togo, for "operational reasons".
Reservations manager Dehabe Gebre-Mariam said an Ethiopian Airlines flight to Kinshasa on Wednesday had been ordered to change course in mid-air and proceed to the Togolese capital.
She said a scheduled flight from Addis Ababa to Kinshasa on Friday would land in Nairobi as usual and then fly on to Lome.
The change was for "operational reasons" but she gave no details.

Zairean rebels, led by Laurent Kabila, have won control of three quarters of Zaire and are closing in on Kinshasa, which they have threatened to attack if ailing President Mobutu Sese Seko does not resign.
Belgium's Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene said earlier on Friday the Belgian airline Sabena has cancelled all stops at Kinshasa and was diverting its flights to Congo's capital Brazzaville.
